package main

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	old "github.com/Agent-Field/codeaf/internal/archiveprobe/directory"
	cs "github.com/Agent-Field/codeaf/internal/clusterstate"
	"github.com/Agent-Field/codeaf/internal/identity"
	"github.com/Agent-Field/codeaf/internal/reqsign"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"time"
)

func key(label string) ed25519.PrivateKey {
	seed := sha256.Sum256([]byte(label))
	return ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed(seed[:])
}

type signer struct {
	label string
	cert  identity.Cert
}

func (s signer) IdentityKey() ed25519.PublicKey { return key("root").Public().(ed25519.PublicKey) }
func (s signer) Cert() identity.Cert            { return s.cert }
func (s signer) Sign(b []byte) []byte           { return ed25519.Sign(key(s.label), b) }
func check(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func main() {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[2])
	check(err)
	var f struct {
		Now   int64
		Cases []struct {
			Name, Method, URI, Body string
			Headers                 map[string]string
		}
	}
	check(json.Unmarshal(raw, &f))
	clock := func() time.Time { return time.UnixMilli(f.Now) }
	client := func(label, which string) *old.HTTP {
		for _, c := range f.Cases {
			if c.Name == which {
				raw, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(c.Headers["Codeaf-Cert"])
				check(err)
				var cert identity.Cert
				check(json.Unmarshal(raw, &cert))
				return old.NewHTTP(os.Args[1], reqsign.SignFor(signer{label, cert}, clock), http.DefaultClient)
			}
		}
		panic("missing archived certificate")
	}
	a, b := client("p17-a", "put-a"), client("p17-b", "put-b")
	ctx := context.Background()
	for _, item := range []struct {
		c     *old.HTTP
		label string
	}{{a, "p17-a"}, {b, "p17-b"}} {
		check(item.c.PutDevice(ctx, cs.DeviceIDOfKey(key(item.label).Public().(ed25519.PublicKey)), old.Device{V: 1, Name: "c2VhbGVk"}))
	}
	_, err = a.Create(ctx, "archived-client", old.CellInit{Head: "saved", Class: "work", Keys: map[string]map[string]string{}})
	check(err)
	_, err = b.Acquire(ctx, "archived-client", old.AcquireOpts{Force: true})
	if !errors.Is(err, old.ErrLeaseHeld) {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("blind force: %v", err))
	}
	check(a.Release(ctx, "archived-client", 1))
	taken, err := b.Acquire(ctx, "archived-client", old.AcquireOpts{Force: true})
	check(err)
	if taken.Cell.Lease.Fence != 2 {
		panic("wrong fence")
	}
	_, err = b.Publish(ctx, "archived-client", old.Publish{Fence: 2, OldHead: "saved", Head: "published", Class: "work", Frames: []string{"frame"}})
	check(err)
	check(b.Release(ctx, "archived-client", 2))
	check(a.Revoke(ctx, cs.DeviceIDOfKey(key("p17-b").Public().(ed25519.PublicKey))))
	_, err = b.List(ctx)
	if !errors.Is(err, old.ErrRevoked) {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("revocation: %v", err))
	}
	large, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[3])
	check(err)
	check(json.Unmarshal(large, &f))
	for _, one := range f.Cases {
		var init old.CellInit
		check(json.Unmarshal([]byte(one.Body), &init))
		_, err = a.Create(ctx, one.Name, init)
		check(err)
	}
}
